text:
I had a great experience at this dental clinic with Dr. Jureerat. She is very professional, attentive, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire treatment. Everything was explained clearly, and the work was done carefully and painlessly.

The clinic itself is modern, clean, and well organized, with friendly staff and a very pleasant atmosphere. I’m truly satisfied with the result and can confidently recommend Dr. Jureerat and this clinic to anyone looking for high-quality dental care.

My wife and I visited this dental clinic to request a treatment plan and then completed all the treatments over several appointments. We are extremely satisfied with our experience from start to finish.
The entire team is wonderful: the assistants are kind, attentive, and professional, and the front desk staff is welcoming, well organized, and always helpful. We do not speak Thai and only speak very basic English, but everyone made a real effort to communicate with us and ensure everything went smoothly. This made a huge difference and made us feel completely comfortable and confident.
A special thank you to Dr. Thanapon Chumnak, who is an exceptionally skilled and professional dentist, and also very gentle during treatments. His calm and reassuring approach truly puts patients at ease.
We highly recommend this clinic without hesitation. Excellent care, both professionally and humanly.

I had a filling done by Dr. Amonrat and she was absolutely wonderful. She was incredibly gentle, patient, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire procedure. The treatment was painless, and she took the time to explain everything clearly.

I have seen several dentists over the years, and Dr. Amonrat is by far the best dentist I have had so far. Her professionalism, skill, and caring approach made for an excellent experience. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dentist who is both highly competent and genuinely compassionate.

Thank you, Dr. Amonrat! 😊

My friend recommended this clinic, and I’m very happy with my first visit. Dr. Amonrat was professional, kind, and explained everything clearly. We completed a temporary filling and discussed a treatment plan for the upcoming appointments. The clinic was clean, and the staff were friendly and helpful. A great experience overall! Highly recommended.

I had a consultation at Rang Hill Dental Clinic and was genuinely impressed by the professionalism and honesty of the team.

The clinic was very clean, modern, and well organized, and all the staff were polite, calm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived.

I was seen by Dr Amonrat, and what I appreciated most was the Dr’s ethical and conservative approach. Instead of trying to sell me expensive cosmetic procedures, she carefully reviewed my X-rays, explained my bite and dental condition clearly, and recommended only the treatments that were genuinely appropriate for my situation. She was honest about the limitations and risks of cosmetic bonding in my case, which gave me a lot of confidence and trust.
I really respected that the focus was on long-term dental health and the patient’s best interest, not unnecessary superficial treatment.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest, professional dental care in Phuket.

Very good clinic. I had a dental abscess, and it was extremely painful, so I decided to visit this clinic based on reviews, especially because of how they treat foreigners. During my first visit, I filled out forms where I could indicate my language level. Even though my English is quite poor and I only speak Russian, everything went smoothly.
After completing the paperwork and entering the office, I was welcomed by the dentist and the assistant. Before the treatment, the doctor explained the entire process to me, including treatment options and costs. The procedure itself was very comfortable and stress-free — I’m actually very afraid of dentists, haha.
They warned me before the anesthesia and even apologized for small things, which was very sweet. Thank you for your care and professionalism. Considering my condition and my preferences, the total cost came to 15,000 baht, which I think is very reasonable for a private clinic, especially given the high level of professionalism.
The reception staff were also very kind and understanding. If I didn’t understand something, they always tried to explain it or translate it into Russian. Thank you so much!

I’m an Australian currently living in Switzerland and did a lot of research before choosing a dentist in Phuket. Rang Hill consistently came up as one of the best and safest clinics, so I decided to go with them.

Really impressed overall. The clinic is modern, very clean, and runs professionally....... you can tell they have high standards and very skilled doctors!

Dr. Apinya Jariyasoontorn was excellent. She was thorough, explained everything clearly, and took real care with the work. I had cleaning, X-rays and multiple fillings done, and the level of detail really stood out. ( Some complex fillings were very close to the root with zero pain throughout the treatment and  after)

You can also tell by the way the clinic is run that pricing is fair and consistent, it doesn’t feel like one of those places that inflates prices for tourists. Everything was transparent from the start.

Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for quality dental care in Phuket (possibly better then Australian clinics that have grsds doing your work)

Also shout out to all the team members at the clinic, whole process was extremely smooth and well run :)

I was very confused and disappointed. I traveled here as scheduled, only to be told that I could not receive the service. The staff said there was no appointment today, even though the doctor personally scheduled this date with me.
The staff blamed me for not confirming the appointment at the front desk and said it was my fault. Does that mean an appointment made directly by the doctor is not reliable? Don’t the staff receive or confirm appointments from the doctor at all? No one ever called me to change the appointment date that the doctor had set, so how was I supposed to know?

The doctor who took care of me was very kind and professional. The doctor said they would call to rush my retainer so I could get it sooner. However, when I actually came in, the staff told me it would still take one week as usual. So I’m not sure which information is correct.
It feels unfair to blame the customer for showing up on the date scheduled by the doctor, just because the staff did not record the appointment. Overall, the experience was very confusing and poorly communicated.

Overall, this experience was very confusing and poorly communicated. I am disappointed with how the situation was handled, especially the way responsibility was placed on the customer rather than addressing the internal communication issues.

Went to the clinic on the 23rd January 2026. Was given medication and asked to come back on the 30th due to inflammation and they could not remove my wisdom teeth. So appointment was made on the 30th January 2026 at 2.30pm - 3pm as per advise by the front desk staff. On the 26th afternoon 1pm, I received a call from the clinic mentioning whether am I convenience to come in earlier around 1.30-1.40pm on the 30th January, I replied why not. So I assume they already updated my appointment to 1.30pm - 1.40pm. On the 26th itself I received whatsapp message following up on my condition after taking the prescribe medication, I replied I am better now and my mouth and jaw muscle could open wider now. They acknowledge and replied should I need to make any appointment for extraction kindly let them know. I was like what? I replied I already made my appointment on the upcoming 30th January. They replied ok and thanks for letting them know about it. I am like don't the reception staff recorded every appointment and call logged to customer after confirming with customer? The beat part is on the 30th January itself, when I was about to get ready to prepare myself before heading out to the clinic since my appointment is at 1.30pm today. End up I received a call from them mentioning that there is someone "appears to" be my mum called the clinic and told them that I reschedule my today's appointment to the 31st January. I said no, no one called them, so i further check with them the number that were used to contact them on the appointment changes, they provided me and I straight away clarified that this number I do not even know or give to them during registration. They said due to this, I i need to go today, my appointment needed to reschedule to 3.30pm instead. I told them why do I have to reschedule my appointment when I do not approve or confirm any changes. So I felt this is totally unacceptable, unprofessional and the front desk team are not in sync at all. For my opinion, the dentist is good, price is ok however the clinic really need to look into their front desk staff professionalism and managing appointment  schedule skills. Customer service abit haywire.
